card.fact_statement: The Star Wars franchise features moon-sized space stations known as Death Stars.
card.source_span: as well as space stations such as the moon-sized Death Stars.

card.fact_statement: A 2012 contest called the Tricorder X Prize aimed to build a medical tricorder device inspired by Star Trek.
card.source_span: The Tricorder X Prize, a contest to build a medical tricorder device was announced in 2012.
